prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE new, separate full-body PNG action drawing of PTO Caine for the existing Encore 2D fighting game, with a genuinely transparent background. Reference 1 is the accepted selection illustration: keep its exact identity, standing-game proportions, palette, mint-green sunglasses with yellow translucent lenses, two eye colors under the tint, red denture with white teeth, black top hat and red band, red tailcoat and dark lapels, white shirt front with dark buttons, black bow tie, white cuffed gloves, black trousers and shoes. Reference 2 is the official PTO Caine product, authoritative for the mint/yellow glasses and worn costume only. Use the same crisp dark outlines and polished cel shading as reference 1. Do not copy the original selection pose. ACTION: HIT REACTION: an invisible hit from the RIGHT makes Caine recoil slightly backwards to the left while still looking RIGHT. Bent knees, arms lifted in surprise, hat and sunglasses remain worn and intact. No attacker, impact star, injury or broken objects. Frame the entire single character with clear transparent margins on every side. No chair, glass, cane, beach, ground shadow, oval platform, background, checkerboard, caption, text, watermark, sticker border, duplicate body parts or extra characters. Preserve all native transparency; no glow around the character.

observations: Recul visible avec les deux paumes ouvertes et les genoux pliés ; silhouette entière, haut-de-forme et deux chaussures dans le cadre. Lunettes menthe à verres jaunes, tenue rouge et gants blancs conservés ; une seule silhouette tournée vers la droite.
